component.name: ompanion
component.summary: Chat with your own omp coding agent, on this computer or over SSH

description.p: ompanion is a client for omp, the open-source oh-my-pi coding agent. It runs omp on this computer, or on your other machines over SSH, jump hosts and Tailscale, and installs no daemon anywhere.

Streaming chat with tool cards and inline approvals, sessions and their tree, a terminal, a file explorer and editor, port forwards and notifications. Model access comes from your own provider accounts, configured in omp.
